decisions.reason: Given industry growth, hiring, and R&D slack, the product's still-uncertain results do not clearly fall below aspirations, so management is likely to keep it while evaluating its consumer-market fit.
As a product line building on the established offer with several models, its results are likely close to aspiration and supported by available slack, so dropping is unlikely.
As a flagship with its own webpage and close strategic fit, it is central to the firm's direction and likely meets or exceeds aspirations, so it is very unlikely to be dropped.
Because it is close to the established offer and presented as a flagship, and slack from industry growth allows carrying uncertain results, the firm is likely to keep it.
